name: network.mintex.module_kyc.ui.activity.KycProcessActivity
description: When opened by the host app, the Verifybloc KYC SDK shows an overview of the identity check, including an ID or passport, a selfie, a legal name, and an estimated review time. The page includes a Start now button.
disableEffect: The KYC overview and its checklist cannot be shown to users whose host flow opens this page.
